correctness.rationale: Every closed-neighborhood trace is explicit on the 21-vertex point-line graph. Prior maximum-degree bound yields size >=9 and P attains it. Independent full-size-nine enumerations using (i) pairwise nonempty distinct traces and (ii) all neighborhood/symmetric-difference hitting constraints agree on all 109 masks, equal to the 1+36+72 geometric family. Independent checks also reject all 203490 size-eight masks. Every single swap is enumerated and matches a direct cone-over-line-graph characterization and four Pappus bi-Cayley coordinate models, with a nine-point/nine-line explicit isomorphism. All 432 affine transformations and all-source BFS independently verify three orbits and component radii and diameters. The standalone local package verify.py was executed successfully; only finite order three is asserted.

evidence: Gravier et al. arXiv:1411.5275, Proposition 2: for 21 vertices and maximum degree four, the established bound gives gamma_ID at least ceil(42/5)=9; construction by all nine points supplies equality. The value nine therefore has no novelty claim.

The final classifier has all 109 minima, three symmetry orbits, exact exchange isomorphism, five components and their distances. No inspected broader theorem or specialized graph class entails those further statements. In particular, applying line-graph identifying-code results to the derived cone would conflate the original code graph with its reconfiguration graph.

originality.rationale: The general degree lower bound for 9 is prior art and is not counted as a new finding; see Proposition 2 of arXiv:1411.5275. The final claim is the exact three-family optimizer classification (1,36,72) and its exchange-graph isomorphism to a 37-vertex cone over the original incidence line graph plus four Pappus graphs. Searches for Hesse/affine order-three incidence graph, closed-neighborhood identifying codes, exact nine-element optimizers, aliases, and exchange connectivity returned no statement-level coverage. The closest primary works give bounds/adjacency-graph or line-graph results, not this irregular bipartite incidence case. Relevant published prior mathematical-record hits on chain/threshold graphs are structurally inapplicable. The checker proves correctness, not novelty; residual unindexed computations remain a genuine risk.
residual_risks: Some unpublished, not electronically indexed, or differently named small-graph enumeration could contain an equivalent optimizer census or exchange component decomposition.
Originality is based on checked accessible research records and primary-source comparison; it is not established by a negative search alone and is not independently reviewed.

value.rationale: The affine plane of order three is the smallest odd-order affine plane with four distinct line directions; its 21-vertex Levi graph is a canonical point-line sensor-identification instance. Minimum size alone is already given by known bounds; the exact classification of optimum codes and the obstruction to moving among them without leaving the optimal budget are structural questions of independent significance. The four Pappus components exhibit a non-obvious recurrence of a classical 9_3 configuration in the geometry of optimum-code exchanges, while the remaining codes realize a line-graph cone. This supplies an exact, natural reconfiguration benchmark, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
